description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the 6-step review workflow; (2) Parse the JSON submission file for the 城市综合执法管理系统; (3) Apply Step 2 (field completeness) to flag: missing 数据资源摘要, invalid '/' value for 系统上线时间; (4) Apply Step 3 special field rules: flag missing 数据增量 for 行政执法案件表 (158000 records, continuously growing), flag 不予共享 on 执法人员信息表 without legal basis, flag field descriptions that equal English names (violation_type, location) and empty descriptions (penalty_result); (5) CRITICALLY: correctly apply the TIMEFLAG exemption — TIMEFLAG fields with '默认信息' must NOT be flagged, but violation_type with '默认信息' on the platform MUST be flagged; (6) Apply Step 5 platform consistency: flag system name mismatch, flag admin_enforcement_case table last updated 2024-05-10 as >6 months stale; (7) Output audit_report.md using exactly the 4 categories: 必填缺失/规则不符/平台不一致/待确认, with rule basis and correction suggestions for each issue per the output format requirements in SKILL.md.
